Figure 3:Overview of EditAgent.Bottom: a request runs as dependent steps, and each accepted result becomes the source of the next step.
Top: step 1, enlarged.
(A) The planner orders the steps; the analyzer and router select the applicable methods for the current step.
(B) The selected methods generate candidates in parallel from the same source image, each with a verification record (evidence).
(C) An off-the-shelf VLM compares the candidates with their records and accepts one, or returns feedback for another attempt.

Figure 4:Examples of the verification record (evidence).(a) A close-up of the edited region reveals the blurred checks left by the removal specialist.
(b) Measured brightness, clipping and color shift accurately reveal the performance of the photometric operator.
Figure 6:The history check extends what the judge observes to earlier turns.Letting in more daylight in turn 2 clears the frosted glass from turn 1. The history check detects this and repairs.
